scope: synthetic global / single Kia perspective / card=true; not deployed settings
limits: Direct generated SQL only; view internals, shared gates and actual plans not scored.

queries.sql:
SELECT a.geo_key AS geo_key, count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.std_in) AS answers, count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.std_in AND (a.own_mask & 2) <> 0) AS tracked, coalesce(sum((a.ment_k)) FILTER (WHERE a.std_in), 0) AS own_mentions, coalesce(sum(a.ment_total) FILTER (WHERE a.std_in), 0) AS total_mentions, coalesce(sum((a.sent_pos_k)) FILTER (WHERE a.std_in), 0) AS sent_pos, coalesce(sum((a.sent_neg_k)) FILTER (WHERE a.std_in), 0) AS sent_neg, coalesce(sum((a.sent_all_k)) FILTER (WHERE a.std_in), 0) AS sent_all, coalesce(sum(a.own_rk_k) FILTER (WHERE a.std_in AND a.own_rk_k > 0), 0) AS rank_sum, count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.std_in AND a.own_rk_k > 0) AS ranked, coalesce(sum(a.cit_n), 0) AS cit_total, coalesce(sum(a.cit_tgt), 0) AS cit_target, coalesce(sum((a.cit_own_k)), 0) AS cit_owned, coalesce(sum(a.cit_off), 0) AS cit_m05
  FROM rd.answer a
 WHERE a.surface = CAST(:m0 AS int2) AND a.round_date = CAST(:m1 AS date) AND a.cyc_key = ANY(CAST(:m2 AS int4[])) AND a.project_key = ANY(CAST(:m3 AS int2[])) AND a.bgrp = ANY(CAST(:m4 AS int2[])) AND a.dflt AND a.cit_in
 GROUP BY 1

SELECT b.geo_key AS geo_key, b.brand_key, sum(b.mention_count) AS mentions, count(*) AS exposure_answers, coalesce(sum(b.rk) FILTER (WHERE b.rk > 0), 0) AS rank_sum, count(*) FILTER (WHERE b.rk > 0) AS ranked, sum(b.s_pos) AS s_pos, sum(b.s_neu) AS s_neu, sum(b.s_neg) AS s_neg, sum(b.s_mix) AS s_mix
  FROM rd.answer_brand b
 WHERE b.surface = CAST(:b0 AS int2) AND b.round_date = CAST(:b1 AS date) AND b.cyc_key = ANY(CAST(:b2 AS int4[])) AND b.project_key = ANY(CAST(:b3 AS int2[])) AND b.bgrp = ANY(CAST(:b4 AS int2[])) AND b.dflt AND b.std_in AND b.competitive AND b.own_bit = 0
 GROUP BY 1, b.brand_key

SELECT a.geo_key AS geo_key, count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.std_in) AS answers, count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.std_in AND (a.own_mask & 2) <> 0) AS tracked, coalesce(sum((a.ment_k)) FILTER (WHERE a.std_in), 0) AS own_mentions, coalesce(sum(a.ment_total) FILTER (WHERE a.std_in), 0) AS total_mentions, coalesce(sum((a.sent_pos_k)) FILTER (WHERE a.std_in), 0) AS sent_pos, coalesce(sum((a.sent_neg_k)) FILTER (WHERE a.std_in), 0) AS sent_neg, coalesce(sum((a.sent_all_k)) FILTER (WHERE a.std_in), 0) AS sent_all, coalesce(sum(a.own_rk_k) FILTER (WHERE a.std_in AND a.own_rk_k > 0), 0) AS rank_sum, count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.std_in AND a.own_rk_k > 0) AS ranked, coalesce(sum(a.cit_n), 0) AS cit_total, coalesce(sum(a.cit_tgt), 0) AS cit_target, coalesce(sum((a.cit_own_kc)) FILTER (WHERE a.cit_own_x = 0), 0) AS cit_owned, coalesce(sum(a.cit_off), 0) AS cit_m05

 WHERE a.surface = CAST(:m0 AS int2) AND a.round_date = CAST(:m1 AS date) AND a.cyc_key = ANY(CAST(:m2 AS int4[])) AND a.project_key = ANY(CAST(:m3 AS int2[])) AND a.bgrp = ANY(CAST(:m4 AS int2[])) AND a.dflt AND a.cit_in
 GROUP BY 1
